changes: Highground uses less CPU and memory in battlegrounds, arenas, large guilds and busy raids, and Reputation's chat filter no longer stalls chat in large guilds.
Withdrawing a bounty reward, removing a bounty, rejecting a kill report, undoing a macro change and resetting a Reputation auto-reply now ask for a second click.
Bounty sharing no longer causes repeated "No player named … is currently playing" messages, and bounty card actions show their result on the board.
Macros show whether a save worked and why it was refused. Translations are corrected across Macros, the hub and guides, and buff suggestions work in every language.
On WoW Forever, capture tracking learns your capture spell and credits teammates. Retail and WoW Forever can set the execute threshold with `/hg exec PCT`, and damaged saved settings are repaired.
notice: Fully quit and restart WoW after updating: this release adds new files that /reload cannot load.
